security: Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share
nature_of_ownership: By MSG Knickerbockers Corp. and its subsidiaries
footnote_text: Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as "MSGR") from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as "MSGK"). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock ("Class A Common Stock") and MSGR's Class B common stock ("Class B Common Stock") in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the "Distribution"), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.
